title: High Quality Genomic DNA Extraction From Paraffin-Embedded Tissue
author: G-Biosciences
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e5ybg7w
materials: Allow the sample to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare tissue sample
steps.instruction: Finely chop 0.5–2 mg paraffin‑embedded tissue and place it in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: First xylene wash
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL xylene (or safe xylene substitute), incubate at room temperature for 5 min with constant mixing, centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 2 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Second xylene wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 100 µL xylene, 5‑min incubation with mixing, centrifuge 14 000 × g for 2 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Third xylene wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 100 µL xylene, 5‑min incubation with mixing, centrifuge 14 000 × g for 2 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 100 % ethanol, incubate at room temperature for 5 min with constant mixing, centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 2 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 100 µL 100 % ethanol, 5‑min incubation with mixing, centrifuge 14 000 × g for 2 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Lysis buffer addition
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Genomic Lysis Buffer and homogenize the sample with a micro‑fuge pestle for ~30–60 strokes until a homogeneous suspension is obtained.

steps.title: Optional Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL Proteinase K per 100 µL Lysis Buffer (optional), invert periodically each hour, and incubate at 60 °C for 1–2 h.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 55–60 °C for 15–60 min (do not exceed 60 °C).

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL chloroform, mix by inverting the tube several times, then centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 10 min.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the upper (aqueous) phase to a clean microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: DNA stripping
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL DNA Stripping Solution, invert several times to mix, and incubate at 60 °C for 5–10 min.

steps.title: Precipitation solution addition
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Precipitation Solution, invert several times; if a white precipitate does not form, add 50 µL aliquots of Precipitation Solution until it does.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 5 min, transfer the supernatant to a clean tube, add 500 µL isopropanol, and invert the tube 10 times.

steps.title: Optional DNA carrier
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL Mussel Glycogen as a DNA carrier (optional).

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 5 min to pellet the genomic DNA and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of pellet
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL 70 % ethanol, invert several times, centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 1 min, and discard the ethanol.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Invert the tube on a clean absorbent surface for several minutes to remove excess ethanol; do not let the pellet dry completely.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL TE Buffer to the pellet and incubate at room temperature for at least 15 min (or 55–60 °C for 5–60 min) to rehydrate.

steps.title: Optional RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL LongLife™ RNase per 100 µL TE Buffer (optional).

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the DNA at 4 °C for short‑term use; for long‑term storage keep at –20 °C or –80 °C. Typical yield: 0.25–1 µg DNA per 2 mg tissue.
